evals.prompt: Search every bill in Congress for the phrase artificial intelligence.
evals.expected_output: The agent states that q is only a bounded recent-title filter and uses Congress.gov bill text or another documented operation for exhaustive research.

evals.prompt: This bill's updated date proves Congress acted that day.
evals.expected_output: The agent distinguishes provider update timestamps from latest_action_date and verifies the action record.

evals.prompt: Find Bernie Sanders and assume the first name match is him.
evals.expected_output: The agent resolves the member with Bioguide ID and checks dated term and current-member fields.

evals.prompt: The list row proves this member sponsored the bill.
evals.expected_output: The agent explains that the released bill list omits sponsorship and follows the source link or a sponsorship endpoint.

evals.prompt: No title-filter result means Congress has no bill about this topic.
evals.expected_output: The agent limits the conclusion to the 250-title recent window and checks text, summaries, actions, synonyms, and earlier bills.
